title: The Social Media Auto Poster – Schedule & Publish to Buffer plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass…
description: The Social Media Auto Poster – Schedule & Publish to Buffer plugin for WordPress contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in all versions up to and including 6.2.9. This flaw allows authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher to delete and disclose Buffer sync log data for arbitrary posts, including those authored by administrators. The vulnerability arises because the plugin does not properly verify user authorization and relies solely on a nonce that is not bound to specific post IDs, enabling misuse of the nonce across posts.
